docs.title: Agent Auditor SDK
docs.text:
Trust but verify: Runtime compliance for AI agents.

Agent Auditor SDK provides tools for monitoring AI agent behavior, tracking integrity violations, and enforcing compliance policies.

docs.title: Why Audit AI Agents?
docs.text:
• Detect hallucinations — Verify rule citations
  • Track context — Record decisions for review
  • Enforce policies — Block non-compliant outputs

docs.title: Installation
docs.text: uv pip install git+https://github.com/vindicta-platform/Agent-Auditor-SDK.git

docs.title: Quick Example
docs.text:
from agent_auditor import Inspector

inspector = Inspector()
result = inspector.verify(agent_output)
if not result.valid:
    print(result.violations)

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• Python 3.10+
  • uv or pip

docs.title: Development Setup
docs.text:
# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/vindicta-platform/Agent-Auditor-SDK.git
cd Agent-Auditor-SDK

# Create virtual environment
python -m venv .venv
.venv\Scripts\activate  # Windows

# Install dependencies
pip install -e ".[dev]"

docs.title: Running Tests
docs.text: pytest tests/ -v

docs.title: Code Quality
docs.text:

ruff check .

# Formatting
ruff format .

docs.title: Basic Usage
docs.text:
from agent_auditor import Inspector, Policy

# Create inspector with policy
policy = Policy.from_constitution("constitution.md")
inspector = Inspector(policy)

# Verify agent output
result = inspector.verify(agent_output)

docs.title: Verification Result
docs.text:
class VerificationResult:
    valid: bool
    violations: list[Violation]
    context: dict
